notes: [P1] outcome-gap (HUD): src/main.js passes `picked` to draw, and `picked` stays null until the player presses 1, 2 or 3. The game starts with the lantern selected (`kind = LANTERN`), yet the HUD shows no kind name until a key is pressed. The brief says 'main.js passes the selected kind to draw' and the issue says 'the selected kind shows in the HUD'. The code comment says this keeps existing pause/speed tests passing, which the brief did not ask for. None of the four acceptance criteria covers the HUD, so this is not P0. Follow-up: pass `kind` from boot and update the pause/speed tests that assume the bar holds the HUD alone.

[P2] layout: drawKind writes the kind name at a fixed KIND_X = 290, between the Wave value (valueX 236) and the HUD buttons. Nothing checks that the name and cost fit before the pause/speed buttons, so a longer name or a 'Wave 10/10' value could overlap. Placing it relative to the button layout in hud.js would be sturdier.
